SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. 6581
Special Branch
REPORT
Date March 14, 1935.

Subject "Citizens Life" a publication issued jointly by the
Educational Association and the General Labour Union
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang

With reference to the objectionable parts in
this publication, unofficial representations were made
with the Nanking agent and the Kuomintang Headquarters
(the latter has direct control over the General Labour
Union) as to the possibility of punishing the editor or
author of this publication which contains what appears to
be communistic propaganda. It was pointed out by these
officials that the expressions used in paragraph II were
based exactly on the Three Principles of Dr. Sun Yat Sen
(a book on this subject has been obtained and attached
herewith), and they regret being unable to take any action
but the Kuomintang Headquarters, however, in order to save
face, have agreed to warn the editor to be more careful
|| in future.

Book to be returned to Kuomintang Hqts after perusal.

Tan Shao-liang
Superintendent

D.C. (Special Branch).
Supt. Tan,
Please return book to
Kuomintang Headquarters and pass
to Key White.
JMS
Done 14/3
Tan
14 MAR. 1935

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别股登记处。
档案编号 6581
特别股
报告
日期：1935年3月14日。

事由：“《公民生活》”，由教育协会与总工会联合发行的刊物
由谭绍良警司撰写并呈报

鉴于该刊物中存在不当内容，已就惩处该刊编辑或作者的可能性（该刊包含看似共产主义宣传的内容），向南京代表及国民党总部（后者直接管辖总工会）进行了非正式交涉。上述官员指出，第二段中使用的措辞完全基于孙中山博士的《三民主义》（已获取一本关于此主题的书并附后），他们表示遗憾无法采取任何行动，但国民党总部为了顾全面子，已同意警告编辑今后须更加谨慎。

阅后请将书归还国民党总部。

谭绍良
警司

副警司（特别股）。
谭警司，
请将书归还
国民党总部并转交
Key White。
JMS
已办 14/3
谭
1935年3月14日

EXTRACT FROM INTELLIGENCE REPORT DATED 5/3/35
......

Citizens' Life - published jointly by Educational
Association and General Labour Union

The 2nd issue of the "Citizens' Life", a weekly
published jointly by the Educational Association, Dah
Chih Road, Nantao, and the General Labour Union, 124
Mei Ka Loong, Nantao, made its appearance on March 2,
1935. It contains among commentaries on current
affairs, an article entitled "500,000 people in Shanghai
out of employment". The unemployment, the article
alleges, is the outcome of the enforcement of Capitalism
as well as the unequal treaties concluded by China with
the world powers through the latter's compulsion. The
problem, therefore, can be solved by the following steps:-

1. That nationals throughout the country unite
together to beat down Imperialism, and strive
for the abolition of unequal treaties.

2. That the problem be solved according to the
Three People's Principles, which advocates
distribution of land equally among the people
and control over capital for various enterprises
invested by the people.

3. That the Government devise measures for the relief
of the unemployed.

（左侧手写批注：）
Safe Jan,
This is
propaganda
emanating from
official sources
seems of
Communist
inspiration.
Please consult
with Kuomintang agent
authorities and
report.

摘自1935年3月5日的情报报告
 ____ 

《公民生活》——由教育协会与总工会联合出版

《公民生活》周刊第二期于1935年3月2日发行，该刊由位于南市大智路的教育协会与位于南市梅家弄124号的总工会联合出版。除时事评论外，其中包含一篇题为“上海五十万人失业”的文章。文章声称，失业是实施资本主义以及中国在世界列强胁迫下与其签订不平等条约的结果。因此，该问题可通过以下步骤解决：-

1. 全国国民团结起来，打倒帝国主义，力争废除不平等条约。

2. 根据主张平均地权和节制资本（针对人民投资的各种企业）的三民主义来解决该问题。

3. 政府制定救济失业者的措施。

（左侧手写批注：）
Safe Jan，
这是
源自
官方渠道的
宣传，
似乎具有
共产主义
色彩。
请与国民党
代表当局
协商并
报告。
JK
1935年3月5日
S2

（右下角手写签名：）
AG
